title: kb_http.py refuses a bad Origin, a public bind and oversized bodies
goal: kb_http.py answers 403 to a request whose Origin header is present and not in --allow-origin, refuses to start on a non-loopback address unless --bind-any is given, and answers 413 to a body over its size cap and 415 to a non-JSON content type; each refusal has a test with a planted failure
